user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I want to create personalized name badges for the attendees. Can you help me generate random names and job titles for the badges? Also, provide me with the current versions of Salesforce that I can use for our company's CRM system. Additionally, suggest some team-building activities that we can incorporate into the event.

TaskList.description: Generate random names and job titles for the attendees' name badges.
Fetch the current versions of Salesforce for the company's CRM system.
Suggest team-building activities for the company event.
